title: October 5 to 11, 2026
summary: All of Set 14's Epics and Enchanteds are revealed, three new tribes join the synergy engine, and the site's first load gets lighter.

new.title: Every Epic and Enchanted revealed
new.body: On October 5 the last five Epic and seven Enchanted printings joined the Reveals page, completing all 18 of each. See translation now works on alternate printings too, starting with Baymax - Lab Assistant's Epic, known only from an Italian scan.

improved.title: Clearer playstyle descriptions
improved.body: Every tribe playstyle now shares one clear tagline, and the four longest group descriptions are down to a sentence each.

improved.title: A faster first load
improved.body: The site's main script is about a third smaller, because the code behind voting and community scores now loads only when you use them.

improved.title: Loading card pages
improved.body: While a card's synergies load, its page shows a loading placeholder instead of briefly saying no synergies were found.

fixed.title: Tribe pages
fixed.body: The While in Play and Trigger tiles on tribe playstyle pages now describe that tribe, not Location Control or Floodborns.

engine.title: Three new tribes
engine.body: Gargoyles, Madrigals and Villains join the classification tribes, pairing each tribe's members with the cards that reward them. Villains alone brings 124 members across every ink.

engine.title: Location movers
engine.body: Chief Bogo - Police Commissioner and five other cards that move characters to locations are now recognized, and a move limited to Hyperia City locations pairs only with those.

behindTheScenes: Plus 23 behind-the-scenes changes: dependency updates, database and tooling fixes, tests, docs and work on features that aren't switched on yet.
